name: tts
description: Text-to-speech: built-in OS engines (say / espeak-ng / System.Speech) or the Kokoro-82M neural voice (config_overrides.engine: 'kokoro', pure ONNX in-process, ~86 MB auto-download). Listens on tts.speak (and chat.response when subscribed); emits tts.spoken with the wav path.

tts.speak.description: Speak a piece of text aloud. Payload: TextPayload with `content`. Optional metadata: `voice` (string, picked from tts.voices.list), `rate` (number, words/min — backend-specific).

tts.voices.list.description: Request the list of available voices on this host. Reply is published on tts.voices.

tts.spoken.description: Emitted (kokoro engine) right before playback starts: metadata carries {file, text, voice, started_at} so consumers can replay or mux the audio.
